title: A narrow habitable world
lines: On a world shaped by fleeing predators, one man does not run quickly enough.
Those Who No Longer Run follows a family living in a narrow belt between permanent fire and ice.
The Nivari have built cities and institutions to keep their vulnerable species safe.

title: The delayed reflex
lines: His sister studies the population, while her partner maintains the living systems beneath their home.
Their daughter grows up among loyalties that an approaching crisis will test.
The story asks how fear shapes a society, and who gets to decide what courage looks like.
